servicesHeadline: What we do, and when it matters

services.name: Weekly Mowing
services.desc: Mow, edge, trim and blow. Mower set at 3.5 inches for fescue so it shades out weeds.
services.note: Mowing high is the cheapest weed control there is.

services.name: Aeration & Overseeding
services.desc: Core aeration plus seed, best in fall. Our clay soils pack hard, and seed needs the holes.
services.note: Seed by mid-October here or wait until spring.

services.name: Spring Cleanup
services.desc: Leaves, beds, branches and the first cut of the season.
services.note: We leave stems standing until April for overwintering bees.

services.name: Garden bed care
services.desc: Weeding, edging, mulching and pruning, by the visit or monthly.
services.note: Natives first. Fewer chemicals, more birds.

work.body: Thin fescue, bare clay under the oak, leaves left over winter. One fall aeration and overseed, then weekly mowing at 3.5 inches.

owner.name: Ruth Okafor
owner.story: I studied horticulture at NC State and spent six years at a public garden before I started Fernhollow in 2017. I still walk every new yard myself. Most lawns here don't need more chemicals. They need the right grass, mowed high, and seed in the ground before Halloween.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: Ruth told us not to seed in June and to wait for September. She was right. The bare patch under the oak finally filled in.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: They mow, but they also notice things. Caught the boxwood blight on our hedge before it spread.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: Clear price in writing, crew shows up on the day they say. The native border is the best part of our yard now.

guarantee.title: If the seed doesn't take, we reseed.
guarantee.body: Follow the watering card for three weeks. If the overseeding doesn't come up, we come back and reseed the thin spots at no charge.

faq.q: When should I overseed a lawn in Asheville?
faq.a: September to mid-October for tall fescue. Seed sown in spring usually dies in the July heat, so we only spring-seed bare spots.
As little as we can. Mowing high and fall seeding do most of the weed control. When a treatment is needed we tell you what it is first.

faq.q: How much does weekly mowing cost?
faq.a: From $45 a visit for a quarter-acre lot. Steep yards and big lots are priced on the free estimate, in writing.
We can't stop them, but we plant what they skip: bluestem, mountain mint, coneflower, ferns. Ask for the list.
No. Weekly mowing runs April through November, and you can pause with a text.

final.sub: If the lawn is thin, now is the window. Free estimate, written price.
